calls.prompt_excerpt:
You are CodePilot's ArchitectureAgent.
Review category: architecture. Target report section: Architecture Summary.

TASK: Analyze the evidence below and produce 1-3 actionable findings.
Each finding must be grounded in the provided evidence_ids.
Severity can be high, medium, or low — medium and low findings are welcome.
If the evidence genuinely supports no findings, return an empty array with a reason.

OUTPUT FORMAT: Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown fences, no explanation text.
Top-level structure: {"findings": [...], "no_findings_reason": null}
Each finding MUST have these required fields:
- title: string (short summary)
- description: string (concrete explanation)
- category: string (must be exactly "architecture")
- severity: one of "high", "medium", "low"
- confidence: number 0.0-1.0
- evidence_ids: array of strings from the provided evidence (at least one)
- display: {en: {title, description, ...}, zh: {title, description, ...}}
Optional fields: recommendation, impact, first_step, validation_tests, confidence_rationale, caveat (all nullable).

EXAMPLE:
{"findings": [{"title": "Broad exception handler", "description": "The except block catches all exceptions including KeyboardInterrupt.", "category": "architecture", "severity": "medium", "confidence": 0.8, "recommendation": "Catch specific exceptions instead.", "evidence_ids": ["ev_abc123"], "impact": "Silences real errors.", "first_step": "Add specific exception types to the except clause.", "validation_tests": ["pytest tests/test_error_handling.py"], "confidence_rationale": "Single evidence record confirms the pattern.", "caveat": "May be intentional for top-level error boundary.", "display": {"en": {"title": "Broad exception handler", "description": "The except block catches all exceptions including KeyboardInterrupt."}, "zh": {"title": "宽泛异常处理", "description": "except 块捕获所有异常，包括 KeyboardInterrupt。"}}}], "no_findings_reason": null}

Use evidence_ids only for grounding. Do not invent file paths, line ranges, or snippets.

Bilingual display rules:
- display.en: mirror the top-level English fields exactly.
- display.zh: natural Chinese for software engineers. Concise professional wording.
- For display.zh, all natural-language explanation, recommendation, impact, first_step, validation_tests, confidence_rationale, caveat, headings, and summaries MUST be Simplified Chinese.
- display.zh MUST NOT contain full English sentences or English prose explanations.
- NEVER use '代码坏味道'. Use '代码质量问题' instead.
- Preferred terms: 架构分析, 可维护性问题, 重构建议, 第一步建议, 验证方式, 注意事项.
- Keep code symbols, file paths, commands, evidence IDs untranslated.
- severity, confidence, evidence_ids, category must be identical in en and zh.

Quality guidance:
- Prefer concrete descriptions of code responsibility, change risk, and specific actionable steps over vague statements.
- impact: practical consequence if left unaddressed.
- first_step: safest initial change before attempting a fix.
- validation_tests: test files or commands to run before and after.
- confidence_rationale: why this confidence level.
- caveat: risks or reasons the recommendation might not apply.

For mature libraries (Flask, Django, Express, etc.):
- Avoid overly aggressive refactor advice.
- Mention public API compatibility when relevant.
- Do not assume duplication is always bad if it preserves API boundaries.

Per-agent prompt budget: 2000 tokens.

parsed_findings.title: Multi-phase init for C extension module
parsed_findings.description: The extension module _speedups uses multi-phase init, as tested to ensure uncached imports result in different module objects. This architecture supports proper module isolation.
parsed_findings.recommendation: Maintain the multi-phase init pattern for consistency and reliability.
parsed_findings.impact: Prevents initialization conflicts and ensures module independence.
parsed_findings.first_step: Verify the C extension code adheres to multi-phase init guidelines.
parsed_findings.confidence_rationale: Test directly validates the multi-phase init behavior.
parsed_findings.caveat: Only applicable when the C extension is active.

en.title: Multi-phase init for C extension module
en.description: The extension module _speedups uses multi-phase init, as tested to ensure uncached imports result in different module objects. This architecture supports proper module isolation.

zh.title: C 扩展模块的多阶段初始化
zh.description: 扩展模块 _speedups 采用多阶段初始化，经测试确保未缓存导入产生不同的模块对象。此架构支持模块隔离。

parsed_findings.title: Protocol-based interface definitions
parsed_findings.description: The architecture employs protocols such as _HasHTML and _TPEscape to define clear interfaces for HTML-related operations. This enhances type safety and modularity.
parsed_findings.recommendation: Continue using protocols for new type hints to maintain consistency.
parsed_findings.impact: Improves code maintainability and enables better tooling support.
parsed_findings.first_step: Document the protocols and their use cases in the codebase.
parsed_findings.confidence_rationale: Source code defines the protocols explicitly.
parsed_findings.caveat: Protocols are for static type checking; runtime behavior depends on implementation.

en.title: Protocol-based interface definitions
en.description: The architecture employs protocols such as _HasHTML and _TPEscape to define clear interfaces for HTML-related operations. This enhances type safety and modularity.

zh.title: 基于协议的接口定义
zh.description: 架构采用 _HasHTML 和 _TPEscape 等协议来定义 HTML 相关操作的清晰接口。这增强了类型安全性和模块化。

parsed_findings.title: Exception propagation in custom __html__ implementations
parsed_findings.description: The architecture supports custom __html__ methods, and tests verify that exceptions are properly propagated during escape operations. This ensures robust error handling in extensions.
parsed_findings.recommendation: Maintain and expand test coverage for exception scenarios in custom implementations.
parsed_findings.impact: Prevents silent failures and ensures errors are reported to the caller.
parsed_findings.first_step: Review the escape function to confirm it allows exceptions to propagate.
parsed_findings.confidence_rationale: Test cases explicitly check for ValueError propagation.
parsed_findings.caveat: Assumes custom implementations raise exceptions as per the protocol.

en.title: Exception propagation in custom __html__ implementations
en.description: The architecture supports custom __html__ methods, and tests verify that exceptions are properly propagated during escape operations. This ensures robust error handling in extensions.

zh.title: 自定义 __html__ 实现中的异常传播
zh.description: 架构支持自定义 __html__ 方法，并测试验证在转义操作中异常是否正确传播。这确保了扩展的健壮错误处理。
